problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}5y-3z+x=2 \\ 3z+7x-2y=5 \\ 2x-2y=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}a & 5 & -3 \\ 7 & b & 3 \\ 2 & -2 & c\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 5 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$

activity_context.topic_title: Representing 3x3 Systems of Equations Using a Matrix Product
